title: [2.7] connection to pump get lost (#72) didn't solve problem
symptom: During the day and night, AAPS is waiting for results from the pump after sending SMB or temp basal changes, causing it to stop acting on BG values. The problem can last for hours, and only restarting AAPS resolves it temporarily.
cause: The pump hangs during bolus and never disconnects from the phone; it is not clear if the problem is on the RS or Android side, but AAPS cannot resolve this situation.
fix: A disconnect from the Android side was added in commit fd934fde2bd6dc22ce71b1e606ae9c8763f7576a, which solved the problem for one user, but not for another with a Pixel 5 on Android 11.
evidence_quote: all i can say is that pump hangs during bolus and never disconnect from phone. It's not clear if the problem is on RS or Android side but AAPS cannot resolve this situation. Try another phone or pump Anyway I added disconnect from Android side in this situation
